tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// yang de gsum bsdus pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'jug pa'i gzhi skyabs su 'gro ba yin zhing*/ bye brag tu theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin pas/ de'ang dang po yang dag par blangs pa las byung bas/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen las len dgos/ de la thog mar sngar bsags pa'i sdig pa sbyong dgos/ de'i thabs sdig pa bshags pa yin pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su bla ma dang*/ dkon mchog gsum bsams la/ de la snying thag pa nas brten nas/ sngar byas pa'i sdig pa la 'gyod cing phyin chad bsdam pa'i bsam pas lad mo gyis zhes brjod nas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur pas/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa de thams cad so sor bshags shing yang mi bgyid do// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug de ltar sdig pa dag pa gcig pus mi phan/ bsod nams spel ba cig dgos/ bsod nams spel ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo/ rjes su yi rang ba yin pas/ 'khor 'das kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang snyam du bsgoms la lad mo gyis zhes brjod la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ so so'i skye bo dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba de thams cad la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug de ltar lan cig dge ba 'phel bas mi phan/ dge ba rgyun du 'phel zhing mi zad pa cig dgos/ de la rten khyad par can zhig la brten dgos shing*/

de'i thabs skyabs su 'gro ba yin pas dus da lta nas bzung nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs snyam du bsgoms la nga'i lad mo gyis zhes brjod nas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dus 'di nas bzung nas snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug go /de skyabs su 'gro ba yin/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum la brtan pa rkyang pas mi phan/ rang nyid kyang skyabs gnas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa cig byed dgos/ de'i thabs kyi gtso bo byang chub kyi sems yin/ de bskyed pa'i don du sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad la rim pa bzhin du bslab par dam 'cha' snyam du bsgoms la lad mo gyis zhes brjod nas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad la bslab pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas bsam pa sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pas sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa thams cad la ci nus kyis bslab par bya/

de ltar byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de rnams dang gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad chud mi 'dza' zhing sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur ba la yongs su bsngo ba dgos pas bdag gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas/ sangs rgyas su bsngo snyam du bsgoms la lad mo gyis zhes brjod nas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan// ma lus blo yis gcig tu bsdoms byas nas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis// bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces lan gsum brjod nas/ de ma thob kyi bar du yang*/ mtho ris kyi rten dal 'byor gyi lus phun sum tshogs pa thob nas/ chos kyi tshul thams cad tshul bzhin du spyad nas sa dang lam thams cad bgrod de myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig gnas skabs tshe 'di nyid du'ang tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ longs spyod che ba/ bar chad zhi ba/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod do// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsngo ba dang bcas pa bsdus pa 'di ni/ yul skyong mgon po dpal bzang po'i don du sbyar ba'o// yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
